integrity: The universal claim is proved analytically by simplex translation, inclusion-exclusion, beta integrals, and exact Dirichlet moments. Finite exact-rational replay is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the uniform simplex law, equivalently complete spacings from iid uniform observations.
The formula does not extend unchanged to general Dirichlet parameters or nonuniform spacing laws.
Classical random-division literature may contain an equivalent mixed moment under different notation; this remains a residual originality risk.
title: Maximum uniform spacing and Greenwood concentration have exact positive covariance
